add-migrate-advisory-lock.description: Wrap express-service's generated src/migrate.ts drizzle migrate() call in a Postgres advisory lock, so concurrent init containers serialize instead of racing.

pin-adsp-mcp-server.description: Pin the adsp-sdk MCP server in .mcp.json to an @abgov/adsp-sdk-mcp-server dev dependency, so the version an agent executes is the one the lockfile resolved rather than whatever npx fetches at session start.
